title: The Open Zaak status-mirroring demo has a start-here build candidate in Maykin
content:
The mechanism is an Open Zaak notification subscription mirroring each zaak status change as a typed operation, producing an independent case history for municipal audit. It is the same design recorded for the Dimpact group; the two texts differ by an article, which is why claim-level deduplication produced two groups instead of one.

What this group adds is the delivery candidate. The single lead is Maykin in Amsterdam, with Open Zaak and Common Ground in its tool column, marked "1 · start here" — the only lead carrying either version of this demo at that priority, the other priority-1 entry being marked "parallel track" instead.

That combination matters for sequencing: the demo has a Dutch cohort that wants the outcome (municipal audit independence) and a separate lead positioned as the party to build it with. The Common Ground vocabulary note applies here too, since the same source row records Common Ground alongside Open Zaak.
